settings.heading: Dandy should work for more people.
settings.text: The storefront foundation includes keyboard-visible controls, semantic headings and forms, reduced-motion behavior, high-contrast states, and responsive layouts — with a final audit still required before release.

settings.heading: Keyboard operation
settings.text: Navigation, galleries, selectors, disclosures, forms, and purchase controls use native interactive elements.

settings.heading: Readable contrast
settings.text: Dark brown on Dandy orange replaces failing normal-size white-on-orange combinations.

settings.heading: Motion preferences
settings.text: Reduced-motion settings remove smooth scrolling and nonessential transitions.

settings.heading: A support route
settings.text: Final contact, response, remediation, and compatibility language belongs in the published statement.

settings.heading: Built in, then verified.
settings.text: These implementation notes are not a substitute for assistive-technology testing or a final accessibility statement.

settings.fallback_content:
Final accessibility statement required
